title: Timken to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences

body_markdown:
NORTH CANTON, Ohio


, Aug. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- The Timken Company (NYSE: TKR;[www.timken.com](http://www.timken.com/) ), a leader in advanced motion technology, will participate in three upcoming investor conferences.


Michael A. Discenza, chief financial officer, and Neil Frohnapple, vice president of investor relations, will attend the Jefferies Global Industrials Conference in New York City on Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, with a fireside chat scheduled for 7:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


Lucian Boldea, president and chief executive officer, and Discenza will participate in the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference in Dana Point, California, on Wednesday, Sept. 16, 2026, with a fireside chat scheduled for 1:05 p.m. Pacific Time (4:05 p.m. Eastern Time) that day.


Timken executive team members will also attend the D.A. Davidson Diversified Industrials & Services Conference in Nashville, Tennessee, on Thursday, Sept. 24, 2026.


A live webcast of the fireside chats will be accessible via the company's website at[investors.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759693-1&h=2607845787&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.timken.com%2F&a=investors.timken.com) and the replays will be available for two weeks following each event. Materials shared with investors during the conferences will also be available online at[investors.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759693-1&h=2307685869&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4493205-1%26h%3D4212469104%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestors.timken.com%252Finvestors%252Fdefault.aspx%26a%3Dinvestors.timken.com&a=investors.timken.com) .


***About The Timken Company*** The Timken Company (NYSE: TKR;[www.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759693-1&h=2790683912&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.timken.com%2F&a=www.timken.com) ), a leader in advanced motion technology, designs and manufactures highly engineered systems and components for customers in strategic end markets, including aerospace and defense, power and electrification, and automation and industrial solutions. With more than 125 years of specialized expertise and a multinational presence, Timken is a trusted partner worldwide, innovating and powering performance across the application lifecycle. The company posted $4.6 billion in sales in 2025 and employs approximately 19,000 people, operating from 45 countries. Learn more at[www.timken.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759693-1&h=2790683912&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.timken.com%2F&a=www.timken.com) or[@TheTimkenCompany](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759693-1&h=4007530776&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fthe-timken-company%2Fposts%2F%3FfeedView%3Dall&a=%40TheTimkenCompany) .
